message.spiresurge.not_lit: The Spire Heart must be lit before a surge can be started.
message.spiresurge.already_active: This Spire Heart is already surging.
message.spiresurge.started: The Spire Heart flares red! Monsters within %1$s blocks grow stronger for %2$s.
message.spiresurge.extended: The surge is renewed! Monsters within %1$s blocks stay empowered for %2$s.
message.spiresurge.ended: The Spire Heart's red glow fades. The surge is over.
